newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Feb aluminium exports up 109.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Feb aluminium exports up 109.1 percent.

text.p: China's exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 35,030 tonnes in the first two months of 1997, up 109.1 percent compared with the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Tuesday.
China's exports of unwrought aluminium including alloys rose by 129.4 percent to 25,384 tonnes in the first two months compared with the same period in 1996, the figures showed.
Exports of alumina were zero in January and February.
China's imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 69,224 tonnes in the first two months, down 4.3 percent compared with the year-ago period, the figures showed.
Imports of unwrought aluminium including alloys were 33,424 tonnes in the first two months, down by 22.6 percent compared with the same period in 1996.
China's imports of alumina reached 90,000 tonnes in January and February, down 39.9 percent year-on-year, the figures showed.
Imports of alumina were zero in February alone.
